verdict.rationale: The evidence never says what happens when a plan's monthly credit or request quota is exceeded, whether that means overage billing or a hard cutoff. The closest items are a per-request, user-set max_credits ceiling that refuses a job with 422 when the estimate exceeds it, a dry_run credit estimate, and SDK retries on 429s. These are request-level spend controls and rate-limit handling, not plan-quota overage policy.
